agency: West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection, Office of Oil and Gas
basis: issue date, by week (Monday to Friday)
cadence: weekly (a report a few days after each week ends)
name: West Virginia
note: Permit actions from the Office's Weekly Permit Report: one list for each Monday-to-Friday week with no day by permit, so a week is counted in the month that holds most of its days. Issued permits are counted by type: new wells (New Drill, mostly horizontal 6A wells), re-entries (re-drill, drilling deeper), reworks (re-work, fracture, convert) and other (plugging permits, about half, and general or emergency permits). A modification of an issued permit is an amendment. Cancelled permits (counted when issued) and approved completion or plugging reports are left out. The reports hold no injection (UIC) permits, so no injection count is shown. The permit records no oil or gas, so no fluid is shown. The Office's map layer has exact dates but one row per well's latest permit, some of them twice, and no modifications; counted by permit number it agreed with these reports on new wells to within 2% when checked (Nov 2026), so the reports are the count. The series starts in February 2019, after the first report (the week of January 7). Weeks with no report (not counted): Dec 25, 2023, May 5, 2025, Dec 15, 2025.

source.name: Weekly Permit Report (one list a week of the permit actions)
